scheme_name: Chief Minister's State Disability Pension Scheme - Sikkim
other_conditions: Applicant must have disability of 40% or more
Applicant must not be covered under Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (IGNDPS)
Applicant must have opened a bank account under Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
benefits_summary: The beneficiary receives a monthly pension of ₹1500.
